chunks: In order to try them through it. But whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, will be given increasing torment by Him.

key_terms.يَسْلُكْهُ: He will make him enter/lead him

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of turning away from the remembrance of God according to Surah Al-Jinn?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual purpose of divine trials: to distinguish the sincere from the negligent among both humans and jinn. It underscores that neglecting the 'Dhikr' (remembrance) of the Lord is not merely a passive omission but an active turning away that results in 'Adhaban Sa'adan'—a severe, ascending punishment that intensifies as one moves further from divine proximity.
